project.name: Coding for Change (in particular CWA Go)
project.description:
Coding for Change is a student lead initiative of computer science students developing free and open-source software for other NGOs to accelerate the digital transformation.

Currently we are working with Cyclingwithoutage.org, a danish NGO operating in over 40 countries that wants to help elders to spend more time outside by offering free Rikscha rides. We are currently building a booking system that will manage over 2000 rides per day for them in Denmark alone.
